scripts.build: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable $HOME/flutter && $HOME/flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons --dart-define=INTERNAL_API_KEY=$INTERNAL_API_KEY --dart-define=AI_API_KEY=$AI_API_KEY --dart-define=AI_MODEL=$AI_MODEL --dart-define=AI_API_URL=$AI_API_URL
